blocks.text: Thin layer chromatography (TLC) mein alumina (Al₂O₃) ya silica (SiO₂) ko paani mein mila kar slurry (gaarha ghol) banaya jata hai, phir usay glass (shishe ki) slide par barabar phaila diya jata hai. Is layer (teh) ko oven mein sukhaya jata hai to slide par safaid solid layer ban jati hai; yahi stationary phase hai. TLC paper chromatography se tez hai.

Slide ke neeche ke qareeb pencil aur ruler se seedhi baseline banayi jati hai. Capillary tube se baseline par sample ka spot (dhabba) lagaya jata hai. Aik hi slide par alag alag jagah aik se zyada samples lagaye ja sakte hain. Solvent chromatography tank mein dala jata hai. Slide ko solvent (mobile phase) mein is tarah duboya jata hai ke baseline solvent level se oopar rahe.

blocks.alt: Baen: tank mein solvent mein khari glass slide, solvent se oopar base line par do sample spots. 'After 10 mins' wala teer daen tank tak jata hai jis par lid (dhakkan) hai: solvent front oopar tak pohncha aur har sample ne slide par mukhtalif heights (unchaiyon) par spots diye. Labels: lid, solvent front, glass slide, base line, solvent.

blocks.text: Sample ke components solvent mein ghulte hain aur aluminium oxide par mukhtalif had tak adsorb hote hain (us ki surface par chipakte hain). Kuch mobile phase mein zyada ghulte hain, aur kuch solid stationary phase par zyada adsorb hote hain. Polar substances polar solid stationary phase ki taraf zyada attract hote (khinchte) hain aur zyada mazbooti se adsorb hote hain, is liye woh stationary phase par aahista oopar jate hain. Doosri taraf non-polar substances non-polar solvent mein zyada ghulte hain aur slide par zyada oopar jate hain. Isi farq se sample ki cheezein alag hoti hain. Jab solvent aik khaas unchai tak charh jaye to slide chromatographic chamber se nikal li jati hai. Solvent front, yani solvent jis sab se oonchi jagah tak pohncha, par nishan lagaya jata hai. Slide dryer se sukhayi jati hai. Mukhtalif rangeen spots ki Rf values nikali jati hain aur unhein standard values se mila kar sample ke components pehchane jate hain. Agar components colourless (be-rang) hon to unhein dekhne ke liye locating agent spray kiya jata hai. Ninhydrin spray colourless amino acids ko purple (jamni) rang deta hai. Kuch colourless cheezein ultra-violet roshni dalne par chamakti hain, aur kuch iodine vapours (bhaap) se brown (bhoori) ho jati hain.
